metadata.title: Santhal asserting it's tribal identity through culture | अस्मिता की दावेदारी पेश करता संथाल आदिवासी
metadata.description: Santhal tribe is the third largest group of adivasis in India. This community has a glorious past to celebrate. The tribal societies are generally a marginalised in the country. But with the time Adivasis are asserting their cultural and social identity. Through this they are also staking a claim in power politics.
